questions.stem: How long is the usual operating time for a stereotactic brain biopsy, excluding localisation?
Why are antibiotics and dexamethasone withheld during stereotactic brain biopsy?
questions.answer: Until the frozen section is back, in case the lesion is an abscess or lymphoma

questions.stem: What are the indications for EC-IC bypass surgery?
questions.answer: Increase or maintain cerebral blood flow, or occlude an intracranial aneurysm that cannot be reached surgically

Before cerebral artery cross-clamping in EC-IC bypass, burst suppression is induced with thiopentone or ____ 1mg/kg.
When is burst suppression induced during a direct EC-IC bypass?
questions.answer: Just before the cerebral artery is cross-clamped
